mechanics.preparation: Call 0x011f21a0, then invoke the active-state slot +0x14 with the mesh; a zero result returns before any state mutation.
mechanics.single_stream_publication: When vertexBuffersCount is one, publish vertex_buffer+0x08 (baseVertexIndex) to both graphics globals 0x01718614 and 0x01718618.
mechanics.stream_update: For each vertex buffer, read description+0x0f as stride, derive baseVertexIndex*stride when active-state+0xd4 bit zero is set, and call device slot +0x190 only when the three-word cache changes.
mechanics.stream_clear: Clear unused stream slots through device slot +0x190 with zero source, offset, and stride, clear their cache words, and publish the new stream count.
mechanics.primitive_count: Use mesh+0x0c when mesh+0x04 equals global 0x016f85a8; otherwise call 0x011f95c0 with the global primitive type and publish the result at 0x01718610.
mechanics.null_index_path: When mesh+0x08 is null, call device slot +0x144 with the primitive type, graphics global 0x01718618, and primitive count.
mechanics.indexed_path: When mesh+0x08 is non-null, optionally call device slot +0x1a0 for a changed native index buffer, update the cached native pointer, then call device slot +0x148 with the observed six stack arguments.
mechanics.error_paths: Negative stream-source or index-buffer binding results return immediately; draw results are not branched on.
mechanics.ownership: The body publishes and caches native pointers without AddRef or Release.
